insights.data_profile: The dataset contains 213,768 records across 2 features (1 numerical, 1 categorical). The dataset is complete — no missing values detected. | Pipeline: median imputation for continuous features (resistant to skew), mode imputation for categoricals. IQR-based outlier flagging applied. One-Hot Encoding via pd.get_dummies (drop_first=True to avoid multicollinearity).
insights.task: No target column was specified. The system applies Unsupervised Learning — discovering natural groupings in the data without predefined labels. Useful for operational mode detection and anomaly profiling. | Stratified 80/20 train-test split applied (stratify=y for classification). No data leakage — preprocessing fit exclusively on training fold.
insights.model: After training and comparing all recommended models, DBSCAN achieved the best performance. It formed 35 coherent clusters with a Silhouette Score of 0.9949 (scores near +1 indicate well-separated, compact clusters). | Model selection criterion: weighted F1 (classification) or RMSE (regression). All models trained with default hyperparameters; recommend GridSearchCV / Optuna for production hyperparameter optimisation.
insights.features: Feature importance scores are not directly extractable for this model type. Consider using SHAP for model-agnostic explanations. | Importances sourced from estimator's native feature_importances_ (tree-based) or mean(|coef_|) (linear). insights.preprocessing: Numerical missing values filled using median imputation. Categorical gaps filled using most-frequent (mode) strategy. Categorical columns ['skill_abr'] were one-hot encoded. All features standardised to zero mean and unit variance (StandardScaler). Final feature matrix contains 35 columns after encoding. | StandardScaler fitted on X_train only; transform applied to both train/test to prevent test-set leakage. Boolean dummy columns cast to int8 for memory efficiency.
